comment: Menu item names read out of the installed 2.3.3 build. The selection-input label is built at runtime from the module's own word plus ' selection input:', printing as Phrase selection input: on Drummer, Melody and CV and Song selection input: on Timeline; somebody should confirm the capital. Light theme and Dark theme are carried by every module in the plugin and are cosmetic, so they get no line. The CV/menu setting with its Instant and End of phrase choices sits among the editor window's controls rather than in appendContextMenu, so its line says the editor window. The Reset and Run outputs are described from the maker's release notes, which say the editor's Run and Reset buttons have matching outputs on the panel for driving your clock; whether Run is a gate or a trigger is stated nowhere, so neither jack is given a family. End of clip on Timeline stays untagged because which track's clip it follows is not stated anywhere.
